integrity: Proof derives exact one-anchor resolvent and point-process Campbell limit; numerical checks supplement proof; priority remains subject to independent scholarly assessment.
scientific_limitations: Stationary single-particle preparations, independent Brownian motions and per-particle Poisson resets, fixed spatial anchors with finite weighted-sum variance; asymptotic T before dense-anchor beta limit. No claims for synchronized resetting or interactions.
title: Spatial memory and universal temporal precision in an independently reset Brownian gas
